paragraphs.text: A loose [Yunnan white](yunnan-white:definition) from Yiwu, made in 2015 from Yunnan’s large-leaf tea plants rather than the smaller bush cultivars of Fujian. It follows the [white tea](white:definition) way of making: the leaf is [withered and then dried by air](yunnan-white:making), never heated to stop its change and never rolled, so it keeps its natural shape.

Made in 2015, this leaf is eleven years old. Yunnan white is [a recent tea in the market](yunnan-white:history), and there is [no agreed view of how long it should be kept](yunnan-white:ageing): some prefer it within a few years, while others keep it for years.

brewing.text: Yunnan white is brewed gently, as a white tea is, in a gaiwan or small pot, and it gives many infusions; the leaf holds up well.

notice.text: Honey, dried fruit or jujube, something herbal and woody, a rounder, thicker body and a darker, redder liquor, with less lift in the aroma than a young tea.
